image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a meat cleaver against a solid black background. The image features a large, rectangular steel blade with a polished metallic finish and a visible circular hole near the top corner. Attached to the left is a wooden handle secured by a metal bolster and a single visible rivet. The lighting highlights the texture of the wood grain and the reflectivity of the steel.
